palette.notes: Clips: saturated warm light (gold, orange fire, magenta flowers) against cool blue-green shadows and snow; sprites keep a small retro palette while the 3D world uses full colour.

lighting: Dynamic point lights make sprites cast shadows; bloom on fires, spells and sparkles; volumetric light and fog; warm pools of light in cool scenes.
silhouette: Small 2D sprite characters (retro SNES-style) stand in a detailed 3D world; they read through size contrast and a lit glow or effect around them, not through outlines.

motion.timing: Sprites keep few-frame retro cycles while effects (particles, bloom bursts, light flicker) run smoothly at full frame rate.

texture: Pixel-look textures on polygon surfaces (stone, grass, brick), softened by depth of field so foreground and background blur.
camera: High angled diorama camera with tilt-shift depth of field: a thin sharp band where the hero stands, blurred near and far; the camera tracks and swings around the scene.

acting.enters: Hero walks into the sharp band from a blurred edge (Dott's town remake: the tiny trainer walks between houses).
acting.acts: Combat beats: small sprite triggers a big lit burst of particles and bloom many times its size.
acting.exits: Leaves into blur or darkness rather than off a hard edge.
acting.depth: Strong: characters are tiny in a deep diorama; blur in front and behind sells the miniature scale.

techniques: 2D pixel sprites as billboards in a 3D scene
tilt-shift depth of field for a diorama look
point light so sprites cast real shadows
bloom and particles on every effect
warm light pools in cool, fogged environments
small sprite, big effect: impact larger than the character
feel: tiny crisp sprite + blurred near/far planes + bloom on every hit = toy diorama that feels expensive
for_fred: For the 'small in the background' beat, put Fred far back in a sharp tilt-shift band with the foreground blurred, let him do his thing tiny, then bring him close. Give one key moment a bloom burst with a cast shadow, and keep the rest of the reel plain so it lands.
